frames.rig: R = camera 1's frame (OpenCV axes), metres; T_cam_R maps rig points into camera k (p_c = R p + t)
frames.D: dome CAD frame, metres, z up (the twin's frame): p_D = T_D_R p_R
frames.pixels: full-resolution fisheye px of each camera's calibrated lens (1280x720), pixel centres at integers

extrinsics.method: lenses refit (KB4, USE_INTRINSIC_GUESS) from the aimed-calibration captures + walkthrough holds (held-out views: p95 1.24/1.23/1.11 -> 1.16/1.11/1.10 px), then sparse bundle adjustment of 50 poses across the whole image

pivot_fit.source: rcm.refit_pivots, 2 passes from the CAD seed, free 3-view RCM axes of data/multicam/20261101_guided_04 (every 3rd set), white reprint rig 2026-11-01
rcm.refit_pivots, 2 passes from the CAD seed, free 3-view RCM axes of data/multicam/20261101_guided_04 (every 3rd set), white reprint rig 2026-11-01

input.name: x
input.layout: NCHW, channels B,G,R, values 0..255 (the net folds its own mean/std)

output.name: y
output.content: [0:2] heat logits (tip, hinge) -> sigmoid in float32; [2:6] offsets dx_tip, dy_tip, dx_hinge, dy_hinge in cells

preprocess.resize: if w >= 2*in_w and h >= 2*in_h: exact 2x2 box ((s+2)>>2); then 5:4 bilinear (vertical pass rounded half up, then horizontal pass rounded half up; OpenCV 5 KleidiCV)

view_match.note: view_refs: {camera: [ref, ...]}, NCC = max over that camera's refs
